verdict.rationale: A registered-agent and business-formation service could plausibly offer a versioned API with a deprecation policy, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains no first-party documentation of any API, versioning, or deprecation policy: the site was blocked by a Cloudflare challenge, and the only community item concerns SEO.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
